استأثرت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْثَرْتُ (istaʔṯartu) /is.taʔ.θar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# اِسْتَأْثَرْتَ (istaʔṯarta) /is.taʔ.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# اِسْتَأْثَرْتِ (istaʔṯarti) /is.taʔ.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# اِسْتَأْثَرَتْ (istaʔṯarat) /is.t
